operator_groups.protocol: Complete static maximum-shape operations; three independent warm rounds, twenty alternating-order pairs/round,100 graph repetitions/sample. External timing events inside each graph exclude host submission gaps. No profiler during timing. Fixtures use immutable sources and repeatable destinations. DSpark append shares one cache after independent-cache verification. Stateless Q/K timing uses matching output-address sequences in one graph pool after independent verification; whole functions keep their output allocations. Other mutable destinations remain isolated. Before timing, compare both backends' returns and written cache/state slots at existing tolerances.
